definitions.explanation: An administrative division of a city.

examples.japanese: {渋谷区|しぶやく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{図書館|としょかん}→図書館：00580_toshokan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{本|ほん}→本：00111_hon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{借|か}りた→借りる：00532_kariru⟧。
examples.english: I borrowed a book from the Shibuya Ward library.

examples.japanese: ⟦{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}し→引越し：03704_hikkoshi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{区|く}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{役所|やくしょ}→役所：06455_yakusho⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{住所|じゅうしょ}→住所：01430_juusho⟧⟦{変更|へんこう}→変更：03616_henkou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{手続|てつづ}き→手続き：05453_tetsuzuki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Since I moved, I did the address change procedure at the new ward office.

notes:
〜{区|く} is a suffix indicating a ward or administrative district within a city.

TOKYO'S 23 WARDS:
Tokyo has 23 ⟦{特別区|とくべつく}→特別区：28159_tokubetsuku⟧ (special wards), which function similarly to cities. Examples:
- ⟦{渋谷区|しぶやく}→渋谷区：noentry⟧: Shibuya Ward
- ⟦{新宿区|しんじゅくく}→新宿区：noentry⟧: Shinjuku Ward
- ⟦{港区|みなとく}→港区：noentry⟧: Minato Ward

OTHER CITIES:
Major cities like ⟦{大阪|おおさか}→大阪：09779_oosaka⟧, ⟦{横浜|よこはま}→横浜：28138_yokohama⟧, ⟦{名古屋|なごや}→名古屋：19405_nagoya⟧, and ⟦{札幌|さっぽろ}→札幌：28139_sapporo⟧ also have wards (called ⟦{行政区|ぎょうせいく}→行政区：26247_gyouseiku⟧).

ADMINISTRATIVE HIERARCHY:
- ⟦{都道府県|とどうふけん}→都道府県：14502_todoufuken⟧: prefecture
- ⟦{市|し}→市：01599_shi⟧: city
- {区|く}: ward
- ⟦{町|まち}→町：00613_machi⟧: town
- ⟦{村|むら}→村：02261_mura⟧: village

NOTE:
⟦{区役所|くやくしょ}→区役所：21563_kuyakusho⟧ is the ward office where residents handle registration, taxes, and other administrative tasks.
